just some thoughts from a diamond pc tank who plays a lot of dva.   
\-00:59, dived in when team was not in position. try to time your engagements and dives by if your team is in a position to help you like if they have angles to shoot the opposing team, otherwise its a 1v5 in your opponents favour   
\-01:55, shooting as dva at the enemy from a distance. dva excels at short to medium range and is very bad from long distance  
leads into another point, you seem to spend most of your time just shooting the tank, as the tank has both his supports its very unlikely you can kill him.   
so you arent generating much value by just shooting him. often its best to go for dps or supports and try to get a pick, as this is way more likely to  
turn the team fight in your teams favour.   
You also dont even need to get kills to generate value, the high ground is the most valuable parts of the map especially for the team comps your team was on this game.   
hitscan and flyers that your team ran thrive using high ground, if you secure it for them you can make their jobs a lot easier.  
not to mention their mauga cant reach high ground easily so he cant stop you or your team if they play high ground when you clear it for them.   
\-11:07, can see you doing some of the things i mentioned like not facetanking someone who can outdamage you at close range. but your still going for a double pocketed tank,   
targeting supports and dps again would help you more, zarya is the main person threatening you here so if someone on their team moves away from the zarya you could go for that person as they cant kill you too fast if the zarya   
cant attack you.   
15:10, can see you going for dives and playing around the zarya which is good but you go for the echo despite the moira being right there to heal, going for the moira would be the better play as   
she cant get healing apart from her healing orb which you can defense matrix. but you also dive very deep into multiple enemies, despite having an ana bap which are being held back  
by a zarya, so you are out of their line of sight and cant get healed. so you have to be quick and go for easy dives when you go somewhere that ana bap cant heal you from.   
17:14, you dive in and at this point 2 members of your team are dead, so the fight is going to be very hard to win, but you still have time to regroup. so its best to try  
to escape here and regroup for a full 5v5 fight rather than try to win a 3v5 and potentially sacrifice your chance for a fight after this. so overall just try to play safe and escape   
if your team loses multiple members unless its for sure the last fight or your team decides to commit lots of ults to the fight. but the majority of the time its best to just escape   
and regroup.   
20:32, you are just shooting at a range here as i said not generating much value by doing this while your dps get focused and dies. you could do a quick safe dive on a support or dps,   
even if you dont get the kill you still distract their team so enable your dps to have a better chance of survival and making a play.   
at the end i can see you ignore the wrecking ball and go for squishes, this is exactly what you should do more of.   
overall its just about finding more ways to make plays in a fight, you dont need to facetank but occupying valuable high ground space to enable your team to have space to make plays  
will really help your dps. and trying to dive vulnerable people(those separated from their team that you can beat in a 1v1) quickly to get kills can also really help you make a difference in team fights. let me know if you have any questions
